breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Do not impose zero end slopes; compute the slope at x = 0 from the solution.' This directly corrects the flawed instruction that set end slopes to zero under symmetric loading. The spec correctly uses only the standard simply supported boundary conditions (y(0)=0, y(L)=0, y''(0)=0, y''(L)=0) without forcing zero rotation at the supports, matching the ground truth approach.
